en: Job 12

p.src: 1  Then Job answered,

en: Then Job answered,
u.src: 1  Then Job answered,

p.src: 2  “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.

en: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.
u.src: 2  “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.

p.src: 3  But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?

en: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?
u.src: 3  But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?

p.src: 4  I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.

en: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.
u.src: 4  I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.

p.src: 5  In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.

en: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.
u.src: 5  In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.

p.src: 6  The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.

en: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.
u.src: 6  The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.

p.src: 7  “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.

en: “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.
u.src: 7  “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.

p.src: 8  Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.

en: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.
u.src: 8  Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.

p.src: 9  Who doesn’t know that in all these, the LORD’s hand has done this,

en: Who doesn’t know that in all these, the LORD’s hand has done this,
u.src: 9  Who doesn’t know that in all these, the LORD’s hand has done this,

p.src: 10  in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

en: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?
u.src: 10  in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

p.src: 11  Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?

en: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?
u.src: 11  Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?

p.src: 12  With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.

en: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.
u.src: 12  With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.

p.src: 13  “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.

en: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.
u.src: 13  “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.

p.src: 14  Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.

en: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.
u.src: 14  Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.

p.src: 15  Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.

en: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.
u.src: 15  Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.

p.src: 16  With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.

en: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.
u.src: 16  With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.

p.src: 17  He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.

en: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.
u.src: 17  He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.

p.src: 18  He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.

en: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.
u.src: 18  He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.

p.src: 19  He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.

en: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.
u.src: 19  He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.

p.src: 20  He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.

en: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.
u.src: 20  He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.

p.src: 21  He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.

en: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.
u.src: 21  He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.

p.src: 22  He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.

en: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.
u.src: 22  He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.

p.src: 23  He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.

en: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.
u.src: 23  He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.

p.src: 24  He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

en: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
u.src: 24  He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

p.src: 25  They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.

en: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.
u.src: 25  They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.
